nodes.label: M-Pesa Webhook
nodes.purpose: Receives transaction callbacks from the Daraja API in real time.
nodes.failureHandling: Returns 200 immediately after validation; retries are handled by Daraja's own callback retry policy. Malformed payloads are logged and rejected with 400.
nodes.security: IP allowlisting, HMAC signature verification, TLS termination at the gateway.

nodes.label: API Gateway
nodes.purpose: Authenticates and rate-limits inbound requests before they reach application logic.
nodes.failureHandling: Requests over the rate limit are rejected with 429; upstream failures return 503 rather than hanging connections.
nodes.security: API key validation, request throttling, structured audit logging.

nodes.label: Event Processor
nodes.purpose: Parses and enriches transaction events, then routes them to streaming and validation paths.
nodes.outputs: Enriched event to Kafka and Validator
nodes.failureHandling: Unprocessable events are written to a dead-letter queue rather than dropped; processing is idempotent on transaction ID.
nodes.security: Input schema validation, no PII persisted beyond required fields.

nodes.label: Kafka
nodes.purpose: Buffers enriched transaction events for downstream streaming consumers.
nodes.failureHandling: Consumer offsets are committed only after successful downstream processing; broker replication guards against node loss.
nodes.security: Broker ACLs restrict topic access to known consumer groups.

nodes.label: Validator
nodes.purpose: Validates event structure and business rules before persistence.
nodes.failureHandling: Rule violations are tagged and routed for manual review rather than silently dropped.
nodes.security: Rules are versioned and auditable; no external network calls.

nodes.label: Streaming Consumer
nodes.purpose: Consumes the Kafka stream for the fraud-detection path.
nodes.failureHandling: Consumer group rebalancing on failure; at-least-once processing with idempotent writes.
nodes.security: Runs in an isolated network segment with no inbound exposure.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.purpose: System of record for validated transactions and reconciliation state.
nodes.failureHandling: Point-in-time recovery via WAL archiving; connection pooling with automatic retry on transient failure.
nodes.security: Least-privilege database roles, encrypted at rest and in transit.

nodes.label: Fraud Detection
nodes.purpose: Scores transactions for anomalous patterns using rule and statistical checks.
nodes.failureHandling: Falls back to rule-only scoring if the statistical model is unavailable, rather than blocking the pipeline.
nodes.security: Model artifacts are version-pinned; no external data egress.

nodes.label: Reconciliation
nodes.purpose: Matches ledger entries against expected transaction state and surfaces discrepancies.
nodes.failureHandling: Partial reconciliation runs are checkpointed so a restart resumes rather than reprocessing everything.

nodes.label: Alerting
nodes.purpose: Notifies operators when a transaction is flagged as high risk.
nodes.failureHandling: Notification failures are retried with backoff; unacknowledged alerts escalate after a timeout.
nodes.security: Notification payloads exclude full account identifiers.
